text:
alex: Heads up — deploybot paused the canary promote for release v1.3.2, job stuck on cache restore. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/12345

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for v1.3.2 (job 12345). Reason: cache restore stall. Auto-retry 3/5.

mira: Ok holding release for now. Change window at 16:00 UTC — do we want to pin to last-good digest or wait for CI infra?

samir: Investigating now. Registry fetches to artifact-store are timing out. Quick log snippet:
```
ERR GET https://artifact-store.s3/redwood/artifacts/sha/abcdef1234 504 Gateway Timeout
Retrying fetch chunk 2/5
```

jordan: Noted — integration suite is also showing flakes on feature-flags tests, could be related to partial artifact corruption.

samir: Short-term workaround: bypass cache on promote. You can run: `deploybot promote --image=sha:abcdef1234 --no-cache`
That will avoid artifact-store prefix restores but will take longer (no cached layers).

mira: I prefer manual promote to the last-good sha and update release notes. If smoke passes, we can proceed; otherwise rollback. Change window still open.

alex: I'll initiate manual promote to sha:abcdef1234 now. @deploy-bot please execute manual promote. :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: Manual promote request by alex acknowledged. Starting promote to sha:abcdef1234 with cache bypass. Marking rollout as manual.

oncall-bot: Canary smoke started. Will report health in 5m.
jordan: Smoke failed: 2/3 pods not ready, readiness probe timed out on service "flag-evaluator". Logs show migration timeout during startup.

alex: Abort rollout. Reverting to previous stable tag v1.3.1. Opening postmortem ticket: https://issues.redwood.com/RED-4042

mira: Adding interim note to release notes: "Promotion delayed due to CI cache/ artifact-store outage; manual retry planned after infra fix."

samir: Root cause: artifact-store route to S3 started returning 504s after a recent proxy change. Infra rolling back the proxy now. ETA ~45m.

alex: Copy. Marking release as on-hold in the tracker and dropping a short note in the release channel. :pause_button:

mira: Thanks — once infra confirms rollback, we'll re-run the canary with `--no-cache` first then normal promote if stable.

(threads ends)
